meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后,AI 每轮对话前自动调出相关历史记忆,每轮结束后把新见解存入记忆库;记忆保存在容器挂载目录中,重启后不丢失。
howto.when: 每次对话开始前和结束后自动触发;仅在使用默认 Claude 提供商时生效。

say.text: 还记得我之前说过对报告格式的偏好吗?
say.note: 会先回忆相关历史再回答。

say.text: 把这次讨论的结论记下来,下次继续用。
say.note: 对话结束后自动存入记忆。

say.text: 我们上周聊过那个 API 的问题,现在有新进展。
say.note: 自动关联旧记忆,无需重述背景。

howto.what_en: After installation, the AI recalls relevant history before each turn and stores new insights after each turn; memory lives in a mounted directory and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: Triggered before and after every conversation turn; only effective when using the default Claude provider.

say_en.text: Do you remember my preference for report formatting?
say_en.note: It recalls relevant history before answering.

say_en.text: Save this discussion's conclusions for next time.
say_en.note: It stores them automatically after the turn.

say_en.text: We discussed that API issue last week—there's an update.
say_en.note: It links old memory without you restating background.
